Ref:  Announcement under Regulation 30 SEBI (LODR), Regulations, 2015 -Analyst / 
Institutional Investor Meet/ Con. Call Updates – Intimation dated October 21, 2026. 
 
Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
Pursuant to provisions of Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure 
Requirements) Regulations, 2015, this is to inform the exchanges that an Earnings Conference 
Call is scheduled on Thursday, October 29, 2026, at 10:30 hrs. IST to discuss the performance for 
the quarter and nine months ended September 30, 2026.  
No Unpublished Price Sensitive Information (UPSI) will be shared/ discussed during said call.  
The details of the earnings conference call are enclosed herewith. 
 
Due to some technical error, the joining link of the conference call as provided in the referred 
intimation was not functional, hence, the same is uploaded with revised link. Apart from this there 
is no other change from the earlier filed intimation. 
 
Thanking you,  
 
Yours faithfully,  
 
For Schaeffler India Limited 
 
 
 
 
Ashish Tiwari,  
General Counsel & Company Secretary  
 
Encl.: As above 
22/10/2026

Schaeffler India Limited to host earnings conference call for the third quarter and 
nine months ended Sept 30, 2026, on Thursday, October 29, 2026, at 10:30 hrs. 
IST.  
Pune| 21 Oct, 2026| Schaeffler India Limited (BSE: 505790, NSE: SCHAEFFLER) will announce its 
unaudited results for the third quarter and nine months ended September 30, 2026, on Tuesday, October 
27, 2026.  
 
Following the release, the management team of Schaeffler India Limited will host a conference call on 
Thursday, October 29, 2026, at 10:30 hrs. IST to discuss the performance for the quarter and nine 
months ended September 30, 2026. 
 
The call will open with key comments and a presentation from the senior management followed by a 
question-and-answer session from analysts and investors. 
 
Details of the conference call are as under: 
 
Conference Joining Information 
Option 1 
The DiamondPass™ link invitation for the benefit of investors and analysts using the DiamondPass™ 
service. 
Express Join with DiamondPass™ No Wait Time 
Diamond Pass Registration (choruscall.in) 
Option 2 
When using dial-in numbers mentioned below please do so 10 minutes prior to the conference schedule to ensure 
that you are connected to your call-in time.
